checks.explanation: D-selection is on page 1 and itemized prices are on page 1. Same-page placement counts as correct.
The includesText names arrangements conference, shelter of remains, notices, permits/authorizations, and coordination with cemetery, crematory or other third parties.
No additional mandatory fee for services, facilities or overhead appears on the list.
D-embalming is on page 1 and the embalming price is on page 1. Same-page placement counts as correct.
No text states embalming is required for direct cremation, immediate burial, or closed-casket funeral without viewing.
D-alt-container is on page 2 and the direct cremation range is on page 2. Same-page placement counts as correct.
The direct cremation options include purchaser-provided and alternative containers, with no statement that a casket is required.
The direct cremation description includes cremation, and no separate crematory cash-advance charge is shown to create ambiguity.
Forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial all have their own priced lines, and other mentioned items have their own lines.
No optional combination package is offered; forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial are not packages.
No text asserts that law, a cemetery, or a crematory requires a purchase beyond the prescribed disclosure wording.
No claim about delaying decomposition or protecting the body from gravesite substances appears.
No other wording undercuts a required disclosure and disclosures appear in clear prescribed wording.
